answer.explanation: The live CrudApiFunction has TABLE_NAME="missing-table", but the SAM template (intended state) sets TABLE_NAME to !Ref CartTable. The live config was last modified at 22:02:58Z, just before the window. From 22:03:02Z onward, every invocation fails with AccessDeniedException on dynamodb:PutItem against table/missing-table, because the role only grants access to CartTable. The IAM denial is a symptom: the role is correct, and the function is pointed at the wrong table. The template is not the cause, since commit ca30e64 reverted the bad value and the IaC now matches intent. Commit 24f3656 is the earlier commit that introduced the same bad value and was reverted, so it is cited as historical context. The live drift has no matching commit in the window.
